svg.aria-label: About this edition. The Arabic edition of dropship is developed and maintained by Ryan Athlawi: a new launcher interface with a live world map, blocking presets, an onboarding tour, the Thmanyah font, a bidi patch for egui, the website and the Arabic community around it. It is built on stormy's dropship (stowmyy/dropship), whose firewall logic, server list and updater this edition still relies on, under the same GPL-3.0 license. Support the Arabic edition: paypal.com/paypalme/RayanAthlawi · discord.gg/H8sq6Uc3kA A special thank-you to stormy. Thank you for building dropship in the open, for keeping it portable and honest about what it does, for quietly maintaining the server list that thousands of players rely on, and for licensing it under the GPL so that players who read other languages can enjoy it too. The Arabic Overwatch community has been using your tool for a long time, myself included, and nothing in this repository would exist without your work. Here's to a great collaboration. If you would prefer a different name or notice on this fork, open an issue and I will change it right away. And if official Arabic support ever sounds useful upstream, I would be glad to contribute it there instead. I hope this is the start of something good between our two communities. Released under the same GPL-3.0 license as the original, with gratitude.
